conditions: factor activation independent of truth, with positive activation probability for the conditional observation
conditioning on active factor and emitted value v
C4.cZero: No active observations exist when c=0; the conditional coincidence is not empirically identified by this population.
C4.proof: Uniform truth plus symmetric emissions gives posterior P(truth=v|active,Fvalue=v)=q. Independent external observation agrees with v with probabilities 1-p if truth=v, and p/(n-1) otherwise. Total probability gives the affine formula; nonzero slope yields unique inverse q. A uniform external observation has zero slope. Unknown activation/private mixture parameters require additional observables and assumptions.

C5.family: same-block equality and different-block inequality constraints on partitions of a fixed finite X
C5.fixedUniverseBound: On |X|=n>=2, every incompatible finite family has an incompatible subfamily of size at most n, and n is attained.
C5.proof: Equality constraints connect components; inequalities are satisfiable precisely when their endpoints lie in different equality components. A violated inequality has an equality simple path of length at most n-1 between its endpoints; that path plus the inequality is an unsatisfiable witness of at most n constraints. A path through all n elements plus the endpoint inequality is minimal unsatisfiable with n constraints. Thus no finite bound is uniform across universe sizes.
C5.equalityOnly: Always satisfiable by the one-block coarsest partition. The finest discrete partition does not satisfy a nontrivial equality.
C5.refinementOnly: Every set of upper refinement demands is satisfiable by the finest discrete partition.
